     Mountain Laurel. Ericaceæ.

     An evergreen shrub, found on rocky hills, flowering in May and June.

     The tincture is prepared from the fresh leaves.

     Introduced by Hering and proved by himself, Kummer, Behler, Bute, Clark, Hæseler, Williamson, Freitag, Reichelm and others. See Allen's Encyclopædia, vol. 5, p. 388.
